name: Head of Arugal
summary: At Shadowfang Keep, Head of Arugal is taken from the mad archmage who commands the worgen. The Forsaken at the Sepulcher seek it as proof that he has fallen.

sections.title: Trophy of the Mad Archmage
sections.body: Archmage Arugal commands the worgen from Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest. Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher gives the order to claim his severed head. The Forsaken see Arugal's fall as a blow against the beasts that hinder Lady Sylvanas's hold over Silverpine. Bringing the head to Dawnweaver proves the archmage's sorcery has been cut from the land.

faq.q: Who wants the Head of Arugal?
faq.answer: Dalar Dawnweaver, an emissary at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest, wants the head as part of the order called Arugal Must Die.

faq.q: Where do you obtain the Head of Arugal?
faq.answer: The Head of Arugal comes from Archmage Arugal, who dwells at Shadowfang Keep's highest pinnacle, above Pyrewood Village and the Silverpine woods.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken want Arugal dead?
aliases: why does dalar want arugal dead
faq.answer: The Forsaken want Arugal dead because he and his worgen pack keep them from securing Silverpine Forest as a safe stronghold for Lady Sylvanas and the Undercity.

faq.q: What happens after the head is turned in?
faq.answer: After receiving the head, Dalar Dawnweaver vows to eradicate the remnants of Arugal's spells and declares Silverpine free of the mad wizard's grip.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you help remove a dangerous sorcerer from the southern edge of Silverpine Forest and secure the land for the Dark Lady.
As a mage, you see the severed head of a former Kirin Tor archmage as a warning of the madness and ruin that desperate summonings can bring, even to gifted practitioners.
